- Do not install packages and do not use the network.

I’ll inspect the CLI, report implementation, and test conventions, then add the JSON output with focused tests and run the full suite.

def test_render_month(self):
        text = render(ENTRIES, "2026-10")
        self.assertIn("tallyho report: 2026-10", text)
        self.assertIn("$62.10", text)
        self.assertIn("total", text)
        self.assertIn("3 entries, average $23.47", text)

    def test_render_json_month(self):
        data = json.loads(render_json(ENTRIES, "2026-10"))
        self.assertEqual(
            data,
            {
                "month": "2026-10",
                "count": 3,
                "total": "70.40",
                "by_category": {"groceries": "62.10", "coffee": "8.30"},
            },
        )

    def test_render_json_all_time(self):
        data = json.loads(render_json(ENTRIES))
        self.assertIsNone(data["month"])
        self.assertEqual(data["count"], 4)
        self.assertEqual(data["total"], "1274.40")
        self.assertEqual(data["by_category"]["rent"], "1200.00")
